title: Climate Change and Fish-Parasite Relationships – A Review
content: Climate changes caused by anthropogenic actions can directly and indirectly affect living beings, including parasites and their hosts. Several factors are involved in climatic changes. Some of them are water temperature, salinity, pH, distribution of nutrients in the aquatic environment and those can interfere with the fish community, whether in open water or in production systems. In this review, we will show how climate change factors can affect the hosts and parasites in the aquatic environment.
